news.title: Jobs report shows strong hiring in March, despite oil shock set off by Iran war
news.description: The Iran war set off one of the worst global oil shocks in decades.
news.why: You might find jobs easier but pay more at the pump.

news.title: Spinal cord stimulator stays rigid for surgery, then softens inside the body
news.description: What if chronic diseases, which are difficult to treat with medicine alone, could be managed with electricity? As "neuromodulation"—a technology that restores bodily balance by sending signals directly to nerves—gains attention, a Korean research team has brought this possibility one step closer to reality.
news.why: Your future back surgery may be safer and cause less pain.

news.title: Speculation Miliband will approve drilling new oil and gas field 'unfounded' government says
news.description: There are calls for more drilling to take place as the UK deals with the energy price shock from the Middle East war. The UK government has not ruled out approving the field.
news.why: Your monthly energy bills may stay high without new gas supplies.

news.title: Research Shifts Toward Shared Mechanisms in Neurodegenerative Diseases
news.description: Leaders in the field discussed a shift in research toward looking at shared mechanisms in neurodegenerative diseases at the recent 13th annual Helen and Robert Appel Alzheimer’s Disease Research Institute Symposium held in the Belfer Research Building at Weill Cornell Medicine.
news.why: A single medicine may one day treat your memory and movement.

news.title: Canada, China sign pledge in Beijing to deepen financial-sector ties
news.description: Canada’s Finance Minister says he raised the importance of labour standards during meetings with top Chinese officials
news.why: You may pay lower fees for your international bank transfers.

news.title: Engineering the bite of ancient marine predators
news.description: An international team of researchers has investigated the biting capabilities of extinct predatory marine reptiles, revealing how these formidable predators could coexist within the same ecosystem. This work sheds new light on the hunting strategies of long-extinct predators that dominated the seas during the Age of Dinosaurs.
news.why: Your future dental implants may become much stronger and last longer.

news.title: Trump says US can open Hormuz with 'a little more time' and asks Congress for $1.5tr for defence
news.description: Lying between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman, the Strait of Hormuz is one of the most strategic and vital corridors for the transport of energy and has been effectively closed by Iran since the start of the war.
news.why: You might face higher taxes to pay for new military spending.

news.title: Oil Rally Accelerates as Traders Price in Real Supply Disruption
news.description: Oil prices surged as escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and infrastructure risks forced markets to rapidly price in real supply disruptions rather than hypothetical threats.
news.why: You will likely pay more for gas and groceries this month.
